end.summary:
Asha discussed how festivals vary by region and may be celebrated differently.
Kavya shared Diwali customs: new clothes, rangoli, diyas, sweets, and gujiya.
Kavya initially mixed up Pongal, Diwali, and harvest-related details.
Later, Kavya stated examples: Onam in Kerala, Bihu in Assam, and Lohri in Punjab.
Teach-back was not passed.
end.parentNote: Kavya practised identifying regional festivals and describing Diwali customs. They used familiar examples such as rangoli, diyas, sweets, and gujiya; the mix-up about festivals and regional differences was corrected later when they gave examples from Kerala, Assam, and Punjab. At home, ask Kavya to compare two festivals by region, food, and one special custom.
